SHARED-F-2-S52.title: Consent Tier Workflow Orchestration Logic
SHARED-F-2-S52.description: Implement core business logic governing transitions between consent tiers (no consent, Tier 1 de-identified, Tier 2 identifiable), including validation rules, state enforcement, and blocking conditions for data storage.

SHARED-F-2-S53.title: De-identification and Safe Harbor Processing
SHARED-F-2-S53.description: Implement HIPAA Safe Harbor-compliant de-identification pipeline for conversation data prior to storage under Tier 1 consent, ensuring removal of all required identifiers.

SHARED-F-2-S54.title: Consent-Aware Conversation Summarization
SHARED-F-2-S54.description: Integrate consent-aware summarization using Haiku to generate storage-safe summaries aligned with consent tier rules, ensuring identifiable data is excluded unless Tier 2 consent is present.

SHARED-F-2-S55.title: Unit and Integration Tests for Consent Framework
SHARED-F-2-S55.description: Develop comprehensive unit and integration tests covering consent tier transitions, de-identification correctness, API interactions, and lead capture enforcement scenarios.
